name: realtimex-mailbox
description: Heartbeat-driven mailbox hygiene: cleanup, rules, retention. Works with any IMAP provider through the Himalaya account configured in BizOps.

api_routes.description: Read a workspace Mailbox profile, readiness state, promoted rules, and last run summary.
Record a finite cleanup run receipt (actions taken, proposals, urgent items), including after workspace deactivation.
Promote a proposed rule so the heartbeat may execute it unattended. Human-only.
Demote a promoted rule back to proposal. Human-only.
Reverse every action recorded in one run receipt by UID.
Explicitly re-provision the profile-owned thread, contract file, and managed heartbeat task.

configSchema.label: Maximum mode any workspace may use
configSchema.description: Global ceiling. A workspace can pick a lower mode but never a higher one.

options.label: Label only (move to Auto/* folders, never leave the inbox)

configSchema.label: Auto folder prefix
configSchema.description: Folder prefix used for audit-trail moves, e.g. Auto/Newsletters. On Gmail a folder is a label.

configSchema.label: Protected sender domains
configSchema.description: Senders matching these suffixes are never touched by any rule, promoted or not. Merged into every workspace; cannot be overridden.

configSchema.label: Run receipt retention (days)
configSchema.description: How long run receipts (and therefore undo) are kept.

configSchema.label: Email account
configSchema.description: Himalaya account name from the BizOps email config ([accounts.<name>] in the configured TOML). Never a raw address or password.

configSchema.label: Mode
configSchema.description: What the heartbeat may do unattended. Capped by the global ceiling.

configSchema.label: Heartbeat cadence
configSchema.description: Mailbox inherits timezone, active hours, and pause state from this workspace's heartbeat settings.

configSchema.label: Age threshold (days)
configSchema.description: Messages older than this are eligible for the age-based pass.

configSchema.label: Aggressiveness
configSchema.description: Controls which cleanup passes may be promoted. Conservative: no-reply, calendar, sketchy TLDs. Standard: + receipts, generic outreach phrases. Aggressive: + personalized outreach, repeat senders.

configSchema.label: VIP senders
configSchema.description: Addresses or domains that are never touched. Seeds MAILBOX.md; edit there afterwards.

configSchema.label: Heartbeat agent
configSchema.description: Terminal agent that runs the maintenance task, e.g. codex or claude.

configSchema.label: Heartbeat model
configSchema.description: Optional model override for the heartbeat agent.
